Idle Agency is a single-player game about collecting heroes, building teams and growing at your own pace. Recruit companions and place them on a 4×4 board, then watch them fight automatically. When a battle gets tough, change a position, add a support hero or swap some equipment—and try again.




The battle can become its own mini window. Drag it to the side of your desktop or onto another screen and it keeps going; lower the opacity if you like, and hover over it to see it clearly for a moment.




Your heroes battle on their own, and the gear they win goes straight into storage. Even with the game closed, the drops keep coming and your agency keeps producing resources. When you return, watch the resource and loot reveal, where epic and legendary drops get their own effects. Then check the Offline Debrief, open chests at the Blacksmith, and give your heroes the best pieces.




Eligible gear can be traded with other players on the Steam Community Market. Not all gear is tradable.




Explore each hero's skills, class and growth path. Balance damage, frontline protection and healing. Levels, ranks, mastery and signature equipment give your companions room to grow. Some heroes also have animated portraits.




Position heroes and guardian spirits on a 4×4 board, balancing frontline protection, damage and support. Class synergies and morale shape the fight. Check the battle report, see what worked and adjust your lineup.




Hatch spirit eggs, raise guardian spirits and place them on the 4×4 board. Positioning and hero class affinities shape their bonuses and combat echoes. Levels, spirit grades, awakening and glyphs make these companions part of your build.




Build resource facilities, research Academy upgrades, and arrange commissions and farming. Agency production accumulates while you are offline. Come back, collect your resources and prepare for another challenge. Item cards explain what materials do and where to find them.




Advance through the campaign and challenge bosses. Your first victory over a recruitable boss brings that hero into the agency.




The full game includes the Trial Tower: choose blessings and routes, climb higher and collect trial legendary equipment and seals. Try a different team and see how far your next run can go.

Set up camp on the frontier, recruit heroes, and let auto-battle do the fighting. You focus on the gear — the grind runs itself.

Crafting is the main event here

Equipment comes in multiple quality tiers, and affixes roll at random. Strengthening raises the numbers, gems add attributes on top, and enhancement levels can be transferred from one piece to another, so you can perfect the piece you love.

Affixes are a negotiation

Reforging rerolls the affixes a piece already has, and Artisan crafting lets you target the exact affix you want. Every Legendary and Mythic drop is worth thinking twice about.

Enchanting adds one more

Enchanting puts an extra affix on a piece. The same item can sit a whole tier apart depending on how its affixes come together.

Six heroes, six playstyles

Recruit heroes with distinct styles and combine core, active and passive skills with talent trees. Skills keep growing — build the party that's yours.

Auto-battle, and auto-cleanup too

While the game is running, you can idle any stage you've already cleared, so gear and materials keep coming. Custom rules dispose of the loot you don't want, so you'll never spend a minute sorting your bag.

The camp is your long game

Build and upgrade camp facilities to unlock bonuses and steady output. The Research Institute grants permanent progress that outlasts any single battle.

Clearing the story is where it starts

After the five-chapter campaign, the endgame tower opens up — an automatic climb for stronger gear and rare materials.


KEY FEATURES
  • Fully automatic combat: battles resolve themselves — you focus on team building and progression
  • Online idle: while the game is running, idle any stage you've cleared and stockpile gear and crafting materials
  • Story campaign: push through five chapters and face each chapter's boss
  • Deep crafting: strengthen, reforge, enchant, socket gems — and customize affixes directly
  • Hero building: six heroes × core/active/passive skills × talent trees
  • Camp management: build and upgrade your camp for bonuses and steady output
  • Endgame tower: take on the auto-climbing tower after the main story

Build the camp. Grow the party. Conquer the frontier — forge your legend here.

You have played the slots. Now you own them.
Build a casino and engineer the floor to keep guests playing. Remove the clocks, manufacture near-misses, and disguise losses as wins. Then enter Owner Mode and use the Owner’s Edge to cheat at your own games: nudge reels, peek at hidden cards, and read marked cards.


The house earns while you are gone. Place machines, hire staff, stock amenities. No clicking, no fail state.


Owner Mode opens on the roster, not on a game. Every machine you own is a seat you can take.


Baccarat, poker, and craps are real decision games where your reads matter, not spin-and-pray.


Twenty-two real casino manipulation tactics, each named for exactly what it is, now working for you.

Notoriety multiplies your income as you clear achievements. Cash the empire in for permanent upgrades, then climb again, faster each time.


From a Downtown startup to a casino in orbit, gated by a 65-node research tree. The take climbs into the trillions.


Eighty-four achievements. The capstone asks you to pull ten trillion dollars out of a single empire. Naturally.

It keeps earning while you live your life. A Welcome Back summary shows everything the floor made without you.

No real-money gambling. No cash shop. Run the casino instead of losing to one.

Idle Clicker Tower blends arcade tower defense, clicker, and idle gameplay into a retro neon experience with a steady pace and constant progression.

Defend your central tower, destroy waves of enemies, and turn every click into power, health, energy, luck, and resources to keep pushing forward.

As you progress, you will unlock new towers, active abilities, specialized Auto Clickers, and increasingly powerful bosses. You will also be able to earn offline progress, open collectible card packs, and Transcend to obtain Offerings that can be used to empower permanent Artifacts and take each new run even further.

Key features:

  • Defend your tower against growing enemy waves and boss battles.

  • Upgrade and expand your tower matrix to increase damage, range, and gameplay pace.

  • Combine manual clicking, automation, and active abilities to optimize every run.

  • Manage Auto Clickers assignable to combat and to different progress bars.

  • Take advantage of offline progress to keep growing even when you are not playing.

  • Transcending lets you reset your progress to obtain Offerings and unlock permanent upgrades.

  • Collect cards of different rarities and expand your collection.

Every great build begins with a single idea.

Idle Commander is an idle loot RPG where every item can change the way you play. Discover powerful gear, combine unique effects, and create builds that are entirely your own. No path is predetermined. Every drop is a chance to experiment.

Your journey starts with a single Commander. Defeat powerful enemies, recruit defeated bosses to your company, and grow your squad into an unstoppable force. As your collection expands, so do your strategic possibilities.

Loot is at the heart of every adventure. Weapons, armor, accessories, and relics aren't just stat boosts, they're opportunities to try something completely new. Mix item effects with realm effects, uncover synergies, and stumble onto combinations that completely transform your playstyle.

Every realm brings new challenges and new rewards. Adapt your strategy, refine your builds, and push further as you unlock new combinations.

Whether you like optimizing every detail or just watching your team grow stronger while you're away, Idle Commander is all about creativity and discovery.

Defeat bosses for a chance to recruit them. Collect 100 boss recruits, choose your active squad, and equip each member to bring out their strengths.

Unique traits give your choices weight: the Worldroot Colossus draws strength from special stats, the Infernal Meridian hits harder near your campaign frontier, and the Starforge Primarch rewards attack speed and special stats. Swap fighters and loadouts to build the company you want.

 

Push into the next realm, or return to a favourite hunting ground and watch the drops fly. Chain excess damage through more enemies and use Loot Echo to give drops a chance to duplicate.

Want a particular upgrade? Search the Drop Codex and travel to its source. Keep chasing better rolls, or tune Auto-Scrap to help sort your haul.

Gear every squad member. Power is only the beginning: secondary stats shape attack speed, critical hits, ability cooldowns, and gold find.

Explore the special stat pool for Bleed, Multishot, Ability Damage, and Ability Echo. Chase a Perfect Item with 100% quality, then build around its exceptional natural power and stats. Save different loadouts for farming, pushing, and trying something new.

Hunt 25 Realm Uniques with effects that change how your squad fights. Turn one ability into a squad barrage, make cooldowns fuel stronger attacks, or channel the squad's basic attacks into one unified strike.

Mix effects to find your own combinations. Pair Aftershock with Extra Attack to hit harder while recharging and strike again when an ability becomes ready. Take a loot build further with the Crown of the Final Relic, which strengthens a selected Realm effect.

The Combiner lets you transfer power, natural stats, and effects across gear types. Choose a starred base and a donor, then attempt an absorption to make the base your own.

An amulet's Chain Kills and a ring's Loot Echo on a pair of legguards? Yes. Combining goes beyond Realm effects: use ordinary gear and special stats to shape an upgrade around your build. Every successful combination opens another possibility.

Complete Chronicle tasks, claim rewards, and unlock permanent company bonuses. Train reserve recruits and develop your Stronghold as your company grows.

Automatic basic attacks keep the battles moving, while abilities, equipment, and squad choices give you ways to guide the fight. Offline progress brings you back to more rewards—and another reason to try a new build.

Idle Demon Lord II combines the addictive progression of an idle game with the thrill of dark fantasy loot hunting. Automatic combat takes care of repetitive grinding, while you continue earning gold, experience, and loot even when you're offline. Come back to sort your inventory, forge powerful gear, push deeper into the dungeons, and enjoy the satisfying rush of ever-rising numbers.

Choose from five unique classes, each with its own identity and playstyle.
Warriors charge into the frontline with Rage and Battle Spirit. Mages unleash devastating elemental power through Fire, Frost, and Arcane magic. Warlocks consume their enemies with curses and damage-over-time effects. Rangers use Focus to unleash deadly critical-hit barrages. Necromancers command armies of the undead through souls and corpses.

Every class features its own skill tree, equipment preferences, and unique combat animations.

With 11 equipment slots, six rarity tiers, and hundreds of affixes, there are countless ways to build your perfect character. Socket gems, inscribe runes, activate set bonuses, and extract or imprint Legendary Powers to create increasingly powerful builds.

Inspired by the gear-crafting systems of Diablo IV, the Equipment Workshop lets you upgrade, reroll, temper, and salvage your gear. Start with an ordinary item and gradually transform it into an Ancient Legendary masterpiece.

The Greater Rift has no end. The deeper you go, the better the loot—and the rarer the exclusive Marks you can obtain.

The 500-tier Leaderboard offers a fixed progression of increasingly difficult challenges, testing the limits of your build and strategic choices.

Once you reach the level cap, unlock the Paragon Board and continue growing through a system of interconnected nodes and boards, creating your own path to power.

World Bosses rotate every two hours based on your local time, with six different Demon Lords waiting to be challenged. Defeat them within the 5-minute time limit, and the first kill guarantees a Notorious item drop.

Hell Tide opens every hour for 30 minutes, with monster difficulty and drop bonuses increasing together. Search for Emberheart Chests hidden throughout the chaos to claim some of the most valuable rewards in the game.

Idle Golf is a chill-yet-addictive idle game where you tee off automatically, rake in cash, and build the ultimate golf empire one shot at a time.

Unlock a growing roster of balls and golfers, each with their own twist on how the money flows. Chase flags for big bonuses, smash destructibles, and watch your earnings compound with every upgrade.

As your game grows, pour your earnings into upgrades that change how every shot plays out:

• Faster fire rate and longer drives

• Money multipliers that stack with every run

• Specialty balls with unique mechanics

When you've squeezed every dollar out of a run, retire to earn Medals and spend them on permanent unlocks that carry over forever. Each run starts fresh — but your collection of balls, golfers, and courses stays with you.

Idle Golf is a satisfying loop of swinging, earning, and upgrading — whether you're watching every shot or just checking back in to count the zeroes.

Idle King is a multiplayer idle loot RPG set in a dark fairy-tale world. Your hero handles the fighting; you shape the build. Hunt for gear with your ideal affixes, refine your loadout with gems and upgrades, and chase your next great find. Adventure solo or team up with up to three friends to battle monsters and bosses together!

Auto-Battle. Keep the Loot Coming.

Explore forests, deserts, and icy landscapes, then venture into graveyards and onto floating islands. Each region brings distinctive monsters and bosses to face. Choose a stage and difficulty that suit your strength, let your hero fight automatically, and collect the spoils. Farm for better gear or push into tougher battles at your own pace.

Find the Right Affixes. Make the Build Yours.

Rarity is only part of the hunt. Search for your ideal affix combinations, experiment with equipment, and unlock more potential through gems and upgrades. Turn a promising drop into the starting point for your next build.

Bring Your Friends. Share the Adventure.

Play solo or join forces in online co-op for up to four players. Bring your heroes and loadouts into battle, face bosses together, and hunt for your next upgrades. Farm, refine your builds, and get ready for the next challenge.

Descend into the Abyss

Put your build to the test against random monster encounters. Each floor brings stronger enemies and a chance to find more powerful gear. Adapt your loadout and discover how deep your hero can go.

Idle Legend is a retro pixel-art desktop idle RPG. Choose the familiar Warrior, Mage and Taoist, battle automatically, collect equipment, and build a legendary party at your own pace.

Use the full interface, switch to a compact overlay, or tuck the game behind your desktop. Your heroes keep fighting while you work or play something else. Come back to experience and equipment earned while offline.

Develop Warriors, Mages and Taoists with their own skills and equipment. Your heroes share an inventory and resources, and can team up for dungeon challenges. Put each great drop to good use.

Hundreds of items make every drop worth a look. Mine, smelt, enhance, forge and inherit to build better equipment. Develop your heroes further with gear sets, special rings and medals.

Explore 22 distinct maps, from the Starter Village and Skeleton Cave to the Cult Forbidden Land and Sanctuary. Pick the right hunting ground for your party, face tougher enemies, and chase your next great piece of gear.

Idle to build your strength, then put it to the test in the tower and party dungeons. Refine your heroes, skills and gear to overcome tougher bosses, climb higher, and progress through Paragon levels.

Progress at your own pace in single-player, or try rankings, the arena, guilds and World Bosses online. The two modes use separate saves. Characters and progress do not transfer between them.

Incremental Idle Souls Gambling Investing Clicker.


You are the Necromancer. Reap the living, turn their Souls into supernatural capital, and build an around-the-clock undead operation that keeps you full to the brim with tasty soul capital.

Dominate Every Soul


Each floor is filled with unfortunate souls. Click directly on the living to Reap, watch the Soul Vessel fill as you progress, and claim the next floor. Bosses, gambling, investing. and making numbers go up. The living fight back, so reap quickly.

Increase Soul ROI


Invest Souls across four upgrade portfolios Click, Army, Tithe, and Forge. The first automatic attacker makes clicking optional. Keep investing until floors that once held you for minutes disappear in seconds.

Build necromantic power


  • Command representative undead companions without burying the target in duplicate units.
  • Defeat boss Covenants and bind eight build-changing Relics.
  • Use the Soul Exchange, Soul Crystal, and Ferryman's Wager to put idle capital to work.
  • Earn bounded offline progress and return to a live campaign instead of a reset screen.
  • Reach Floor 100, Ascend for permanent Black Sigils, and retrace your steps with enhanced power.
  • Push through a 200-floor initial campaign crossing dark-fantasy regions and a more demanding second cycle.
  • Steam Achievements!

Much more still to come, we're just getting started!

Full version release scheduled in October 2026.

Build Your Own Underwater Paradise!

Idle Reef is a relaxing and captivating ecosystem-building game set in the depths of the ocean. Sit back after a stressful day, dive into the deep blue, and transform a barren seabed into a vibrant, colorful coral reef teeming with life.

Create Your Ecosystem Starting with just a small piece of coral, you will eventually attract hundreds of different marine creatures to your reef—from jellyfish and clownfish to sea turtles and majestic whales. Manage your resources to unlock new species, expand your habitat, and set the rhythm of your ocean.

Key Features

  • Effortless Progression: Whether you play actively to speed up your growth or simply sit back and watch your reef flourish peacefully on its own, the choice is yours.

  • Rich Biodiversity: Customize your reef with dozens of different coral, algae, and fish species to unlock and upgrade.

  • Explore the Depths: Dive deeper into the ocean to discover hidden secrets, sunken treasures, and rare mythical underwater creatures.

  • Relaxing Atmosphere: Experience a meditative journey with mesmerizing underwater visuals and soothing soundtracks designed to wash away the day's fatigue.

A Deep Breath, Free from Stress Whether you are a player who loves optimizing every resource or someone who just wants to enjoy the serenity of the underwater world on your screen... Idle Reef offers an experience you can play entirely at your own pace.

Answer the call of the ocean. Add to your wishlist now and start your underwater adventure today!

Idle Slots: Casino HQ is the ultimate idle/incremental game for anyone who loves watching numbers go exponentially up! You start with nothing but a dream, a handful of change, and a single Penny Slot. Before long, you’ll be managing a massive casino floor, hiring shady Pit Bosses to do your dirty work, and launching "Galaxy Slots" into orbit to attract billionaire aliens.

No actual gambling required—just pure, unadulterated dopamine as your bankroll goes from $100 to numbers that mathematicians haven't even named yet!

🎰 THE CORE LOOP: SPIN, WIN, UPGRADE

Click the handle to spin the reels, earn cash, and reinvest it right back into your floor. Upgrade to Nickel, Quarter, and Dollar slots, all the way up to the exclusive Crypto and Rocket Slots!

👔 AUTOMATE THE HUSTLE

Tired of clicking? We thought so. Hire Pit Bosses to spin the machines for you. Level them up to unlock massive speed boosts and payout multipliers. Your casino never sleeps, even when you do!

✨ MASTER "SYNERGIES" (It's Free Real Estate)

This isn't just a mindless clicker. The layout of your casino floor matters. Unlock powerful Synergies by balancing your machines.

  • Keep your Penny and Nickel slots grouped together for Beginner's Luck.

  • Balance your mid-tier machines to unlock the Balance Sheet bonus.

  • Use your cheap slots to artificially drive up the hype (and payouts) of your High Roller machines!

📈 SCHMOOZE FOR UPGRADES

Spend time "schmoozing" to unlock permanent game-changing upgrades. Grease some bearings to speed up the reels, offer service drinks to lower your machine costs, or learn the fine art of Card Counting to quadruple your profits.

🤝 CASH OUT & CORPORATE TAKEOVERS (Prestige System)

Reached a trillion dollars? Good. Sell the whole casino. Cashing out resets your progress, but rewards you with highly coveted 4-Leaf Clovers (massive global multipliers) and CFOs. Use your new executive team to sign legally questionable contracts like Negotiation (cheaper Pit Bosses) or a Trust Fund (start your next run rich).

🎨 PIMP YOUR CASINO

Unlock dozens of themes to customize your game. From Cyberpunk "Synthwave" and "Hacker Green" to "Space Explorer" and "New Years." Play in style!

Features at a glance:

  • 10 distinct Slot Machines to unlock and master.

  • Deep Synergy System: Strategize your floor layout for massive combo boosts.

  • Pit Boss Automation: Level up your staff to level up your profits.

  • High Roller VIP Mode: Activate your active skill for a frenzy of 2x payouts!

  • Robust Prestige System: Sell the casino, gain CFOs, and unlock permanent, game-breaking perks.

  • 30+ Unlockable Themes: Customize the UI to match your vibe.

What are you waiting for? The house always wins... and you're the house. Get Idle Slots: Casino HQ today!

Your adventure is centered in a small town that serves as you home. Between adventures, return to its tavern, shop, church and prepare your party for what comes next. Hire new companions, trade equipment and revive those who didn't make it back on their feet.

When you are ready venture out on quests to earn experience, collect loot and grow stronger. Then return home, make changes and prepare for the next expedition, and eventually, the next boss standing in your way.

Build a party

Potential recruits arrive at the tavern each day. Chose who joins your party, kick members that no longer fit your plans and build a team around your preferred playstyle.

Gear up

Find new items through enemy drops, loot spots, quest rewards and merchants. Buy, sell and enchant items to strengthen your party and shape your builds.

Embark on quests, defeat bosses

Take on quests to earn experience, gather better gear and strengthen your party. Defeat powerful bosses to progress and unlock tougher challenges and greater rewards.

Anyone can learn magic

Spells are not locked behind traditional character roles, teach fireball to your warrior, heal to your archer or build a classical spellcaster. The choice is yours.

Level up, combine masteries into classes

Every character can learn multiple masteries that can be combined into classes. Blade + Fire becomes Battlemage, Healing + Defense becomes Templar, Death + Life becomes Necromancer, Fire+Ice+Lightning becomes Elemental Wizard etc..

Upgrade shop

Upgrade the town's shop to unlock new vendors, giving you access to more ways to prepare and improve your party.

Made with handhelds in mind

With full controller support and a clear pixel-art 3D style, the game is well suited for handheld devices as well as traditional desktop play.

Choose Your Weapon, Shape Your Build

Discover distinct attack styles with flying swords and weapons inspired by traditional Chinese arts. Combine gear affixes and talent choices to build a playstyle around your favorite weapon.

Hunt for Loot, Refine Your Gear

Collect magical gear on your adventures and seek out items and affix combinations that suit your build. Reroll affixes, upgrade your finds, and refine your gear to bring your build together.

Your Backpack Is Your Loadout

Fit gear of different shapes into your backpack, balancing limited space with powerful combinations. Arrange items around their effects and make use of adjacency bonuses to build a winning loadout.

《Immortal Sect Defend》In the vast and perilous world of cultivation, countless sects stand tall, yet the path to immortality is fraught with danger.As a core disciple of your sect, you bear the solemn duty of guarding the Sect Eye — the very foundation of your sect’s fate and spiritual veins. Should the Sect Eye fall to the demonic hordes, thousands of years of legacy will crumble to dust, and the entire sect will face annihilation.You are the last line of defense. Alone, you must withstand waves of enemies attacking from all directions.

Core Gameplay: Sect Guardian

  • Ironclad Defense: Deploy powerful defensive immortal towers around the Sect Eye. From basic Attack Towers and Slowing Towers to advanced formations, each tower possesses unique immortal arts. You must strategically combine them according to the enemies’ attributes and attack patterns to build an impenetrable line of defense.

  • Exploration and Conquest: When the defense line is temporarily secure, venture beyond the Sect Eye into dangerous secret realms. Slay roaming demonic beasts, challenge powerful outer demons, and collect rare spiritual materials and ancient immortal treasures.

  • Growth Loop: Use the spirit stones and immortal resources gained from exploration to upgrade your defensive towers and unlock powerful immortal skills. Every resource becomes a sharp blade for protecting the sect, allowing you to stand firm against even fiercer demonic assaults.

Game Features

  • Intense Tower Defense Battles: Progressive waves of enemies, elite monsters, and epic bosses test your strategy and quick thinking in every round.

  • Free Exploration in the Cultivation World: Delve into sect secret realms, ancient ruins, and perilous demon domains.

  • Deep Cultivation System: Tower advancement, immortal skill upgrades, and companion nurturing offer multi-dimensional growth paths.

  • Unique Immortal Tower Defense Experience: Seamlessly switch between meticulously planning an iron defense and personally wielding your sword to slay demons.

The fate of the sect hangs in the balance.
Will you hold the line and defend step by step?
Or will you take the initiative and strike first?

Choose your Kingdom!

Construction

Build up your economy and create transport routes.

Logistics and Production

Gather resources and transport them to your capital city. Produce materials for your economy and expand your army.

Military Templates

Create templates for your military units. Keep an eye on your available equipment!

Explore

Send scouts to explore new regions and find resources.

Sieges and Raids

Dominate your enemies in sieges and raids!

Features

  • Eight Kingdoms

  • Gather resources and transport them to your capital city

  • Produce materials in your capital city

  • Expand your army

  • Conquer new regions

  • Research new technologies

Imperium is a single-player 4X space strategy game about building a civilization among the stars. Begin with one colony and a single home star, then expand across a galaxy of alien worlds - researching exotic science, designing your own fleets, and bending rival empires to your will through diplomacy or open war. Every game generates a new galaxy, a new balance of power, and a new empire to call your own.

Colonize a Living Galaxy

  • Explore procedurally generated galaxies ranging from a dozen systems to well over a hundred.

  • Settle planets, moons, and asteroids - each with a surface you develop tile by tile.

  • Construct more than 50 surface structures and orbital installations: factories, laboratories, hydroponic gardens, defense towers, embassies, and more.

  • Terraform hostile worlds and uncover ancient ruins left behind by a vanished civilization.

  • Hand any colony to a Governor and let it run itself

Design Your Own Fleets

  • Engineer warships from the keel up across five hull classes, from nimble scouts to colossal capital ships.

  • Combine more than 80 components - power cores, drives, scanners, shields, and an arsenal of exotic weaponry.

  • No two commanders fly the same fleet. Two players using identical hulls can wage completely different wars.

Research Exotic Technologies

  • Advance through a tech tree of 68 technologies, from your first orbital shipyard to the frontier of exotic physics.

  • Harness serious, far-future science: gravity manipulation, frequency-based weaponry, and technologies most 4X games never touch.

  • Unlock late-game breakthroughs that reshape how your empire wages war, negotiates, and wins.

Rule Through Diplomacy or War

  • Share the galaxy with 21 playable species - Veylilith, Phasaryn, Oculari, Litharrak, and many more - each with its own homeworld, fleet aesthetic, soundtrack, and signature ability.

  • Run diplomacy as a real economy: allocate your influence across courtship, governance, and espionage, build embassies into full diplomatic missions, and spy on rivals through fleet and diplomatic surveillance.

  • Negotiate non-aggression pacts, trade and research agreements, and full alliances - or declare war, extract reparations, and force a peace on your terms.

  • Rise to lead a Galactic Senate: build toward an electable Premier's seat, or seize the throne as Emperor and defend it through the civil war that follows.

  • Outthink rival empires driven by distinct AI personalities that scheme, expand, and fight each other in character - not just against you.

Claim Victory Your Way

  • Triumph through military elimination, territorial supremacy, conquest of every home star, a galaxy-wide peace, or by winning the political game as Senate Premier or Emperor - six ways to win, each demanding a different empire.

  • Shape every playthrough: choose your galaxy size, the number of rival empires, and the temperament of the galaxy itself.

Crafted to Be Played

  • A deep 4X wrapped in a clean, modern interface - atmospheric visuals and a sci-fi soundtrack.

  • Characterful AI that makes every rival empire feel like an opponent worth beating.

  • Built-in modding tools let you reshape the tech tree and redesign the game's items.

  • A guided first empire eases new players in, and it's gone the moment you don't need it.

The galaxy is waiting. Make it your Imperium.

Most strategy games give you a map. Imperium Sine Fine gives you a world that lives.

Your finest general will grow old and die. The city you conquered last winter resents your rule, and crime is taking root in its alleys. Your border provinces are filling with settlers of three different races, each assimilating, or not, at their own pace. And somewhere to the south, a rival emperor has noticed your armies growing weak and hungry, faster than you can feed them.

This is grand strategy where every system breathes. Welcome to Imperium Sine Fine, the Empire Without End.

FORGE YOUR EMPIRE

Command one of 14 factions, from noble human kingdoms and ancient elven dominions to brutal orc hordes and the chillingly efficient unliving, each with its own government form, strengths, and military traditions. Expand across a vast hexagonal map by founding cities, claiming resource-rich terrain, and raising outposts on the frontier. Hills yield stone, plains yield grain, and the empire that controls the right ground controls its own destiny.

RULE A LIVING WORLD

This is not a game of static numbers. Populations of multiple races grow, migrate, and assimilate. Cities prosper or fall into crime depending on how you govern them. Generals and governors gain experience, learn new skills, age, and eventually die, forcing you to plan beyond a single lifetime. Loyalty must be earned, garrisons must be maintained, and a poorly fed army is an army half-beaten before the first battle.

WAGE WAR WITH DEPTH

Customise your armies down to equipment loadouts and troop traits. Veteran regiments earn Battle Honours that shape how they fight. Deploy engineers to raise fortifications and improve the land your soldiers bleed for. Face AI opponents with distinct military personalities, some cautious, some reckless, none of them predictable.

MASTER DIPLOMACY AND INTRIGUE

Strike alliances, drag allies into your wars, return conquered cities as bargaining chips, and navigate an Imperial Court where influence is a weapon as sharp as any blade. Will you rule as a wise sovereign or a ruthless conqueror? The world will remember either way.

MAKE IT YOURS

Full mod support with Steam Workshop integration. Edit game data, replace graphics, and subscribe to community creations with a single click. With the Eternal Creation Scenario Editor DLC, you can build entire scenarios of your own and share them too. A journey that began with Rising Empires in 2013 and grew through the Fate of an Empire saga, Imperium Sine Fine arrives with a decade of refinement, a dedicated community, and the toolset to match.

ONE DEVELOPER. ONE VISION. NO COMPROMISES.

Imperium Sine Fine is built by a solo developer with a single design rule: every system must create interesting decisions, never busywork. No microtransactions, no energy timers, no live-service nonsense. Just deep, honest grand strategy.

Are you ready to forge your legacy and rule an empire without end?

Imperium of the Stars is a single-player Gothic real-time 4X grand strategy game. Build an empire, govern its worlds, and command its fleets.

After three centuries of isolation, scattered civilizations reach for the stars again. Distant beacons burn above lost colonies. Choose one of four distinct factions and decide how your realm will endure.

  • Four playable factions: Distinct economies, technologies, and institutions shape how you rule.

  • Choose your galaxy: Generate 1,000 to 10,000 star systems with configurable shape and density.

  • A living galaxy: Events, Situations, and crises test your decisions.

  • Command at any scale: Delegate to governors or command individual worlds and fleets.

  • War in real time: Fight fleet actions and planetary sieges. The great powers cannot negotiate peace.

  • Choose your director: The Balanced Hand and The Iron Scales offer different experiences. Retune your chosen director mid-campaign.

The Imperium

Reunite scattered worlds through Faith. Govern through the Court, Choir, and Great Houses, balancing their demands as the Reclamation advances.

The Void Eternal

Draw worlds into Oblivion. Deepen Communion and attune to the Void's Aspects, choosing the powers that shape your realm.

The Grokhar

Unite rival packs through strength. Turn salvage into ships and develop your Pack-Lord to command the growing Grokhar host.

The Lattice

Enter the galaxy for the first time as a crystalline Host. Consume biomass, choose permanent Adaptations, and prepare the Awakening.

Petitions and dilemmas come before the Throne. Your choices shift loyalties and shape later events. During a supply collapse, open the stores and restore food production before hardship becomes unrest.

Living Sagas follow your reign. The Reclamation charts the Imperium's return to the lost stars, shaped by the realm you build and the oaths you keep.

Deploy fleets across dozens of ship classes. Follow 2D engagements and land regiments for sieges where terrain and morale matter.

Build across your empire or let governors develop their sectors. Set a Grand Campaign's commitment and risk; it musters task forces and conducts the offensive. Take direct control whenever you choose.

Ten thousand worlds. One throne. The candle holds.

Inspired by a forbidden Italian theory proposed by an official Bible translator, the Hebrew term “Elohim” may have been mistranslated, a word that can mean both singular and plural. In the original scriptures, there is no single God, but multiple entities: ancient, warlike, and inhuman

After a devastating battle, the Elohim abandoned our world, vowing to return. But not all of them left

One renegade Elohim remained, hiding within the shadows of a cathedral, patiently shaping a prophecy

Its purpose is not salvation
Its purpose is to create the new prophet

Drink the wine, made from the blood of an Elohim, to uncover the truth and find your wife, who vanished during a cathedral investigation

  • Explore the cathedral and its hidden foundations

  • Use the objects you find to clear your path

  • Solve environmental puzzles, designed to prevent a horrifying creature from finding and killing the Elohim

  • Reach the next chalice, it’s the only way to discover what happened to your wife

In Vino Veritas will make you question whether everything you’ve ever been told is true… or just a carefully built illusion

You’ll feel the echoes of the cathedral seep into your bones

InFlood is a post-apocalyptic open-world RPG built around an inviting atmosphere, balanced combat against sea creatures, and the mysterious stories of those who dwell on land.

EXPLORE THE WORLD

Explore the open world, discover diverse regions and their societies and customs, and encounter rival coalitions and intriguing characters.

DIVE INTO THE STORY

You have lost your memory and remember nothing of your past, but in this vast world you will never be alone: always at your side is a faithful companion—a portable navigation module equipped with an artificial intelligence system called ORA. Together, you will uncover the truth about who you are, one step at a time.

UPGRADE YOUR SHIP

Your ship is both your primary tool and your means of travel. You can—and should—upgrade and modify it, unlocking new abilities by welcoming new members aboard.

STUDY THE WEATHER

Nature and the weather directly shape your journey: a fair wind fills your sails and propels your ship forward, while a headwind slows you down. Winds vary in strength and direction.

The engine allows your ship to maintain a steady speed, but consumes fuel. Waves can throw off your aim. Their height depends on the weather and wind strength. During a storm, you are more likely to miss.

ABOUT THE TEAM

We are a small team of enthusiasts led by our creative visionary—a devoted lover of the sea and sailing adventures. We have poured more than three years into the game, and we hope you will feel the wind of freedom fill your chest and the thrill of adventure tingle in your fingertips when you set sail into this wondrous new world. Bon voyage!

A late-night call. An open door. A residence that should have stayed silent.

Incident Reports: Millers Residence is a short first-person psychological horror game about investigation, unease, and the disturbing truth hidden inside an old residence.

You play as a 1980s police investigator dispatched to an isolated home after a brief emergency call. What begins as a routine response quickly turns into something far more unsettling. The house is quiet, but every room tells a story.

Search the residence, examine objects, read documents, and piece together the events that led to the night’s horror. A dinner left unfinished. Files stacked in the dark. Personal belongings placed with intent. Strange symbols, handwritten notes, and blood-stained details point toward something someone tried to hide.

There are no easy answers waiting for you here. Only fragments, evidence, and the growing feeling that something inside the house is watching.

Features

  • First-person psychological horror

  • Investigation-focused exploration

  • Environmental storytelling through objects, notes, and visual details

  • A tense, atmospheric residence filled with disturbing clues

  • Short, linear horror experience built around mood and mystery

Incremental Magic is a 2D action clicker where you take down monsters yourself with your mouse. It isn't an idle game you leave running — aiming, firing, and breaking things is the whole point.

Click, drag, scroll

Every skill lives at your fingertips. Click to unleash it, drag and scroll to command the fight — where you aim and when you strike is your skill.

8 dungeons, 8 bosses

Not one endless track. Journey through 8 unique dungeons, each ending in its own boss.
  • Nameless Forest → Hidden Cave → Distant Abyss → Abandoned Cemetery → Quiet Meadow → Desert of Death → Spirit Realm → Dragon's Nest

A build of your own

Shape each run through a branching skill tree — every playthrough builds differently, and the stronger you get, the deeper the dungeons open.

Wishlist now to be the first to know when Incremental Magic launches.

Play pachinko. Earn medals. Spend them on upgrades, and watch the next day get busier than the last.

Upgrade!

Explore a skill tree full of upgrades that change how you earn. Spend your medals to unlock nodes and open up new ways to make money.

Combos... critical hits... slots... what do you upgrade first?

Two gacha machines... and the runes combine into Rune Words??

Build. Scale. Deploy.

Start with scraps. End with armies that flood the map.

In Incremental RTS you don’t command units. You build the production machine, pick the upgrades path, balance economics and decide how your army grows.

The classic RTS fantasy of just spawning a huge force and sending it, except the “sending it” part happens on its own.

Choose your path

Specialize in swarms, artillery, snipers, tanks, or massive unstoppable units. Mix them or go all-in. Every path scales differently, and the enemy always has challenges for you. Adapt or get overrun. Some runs collapse early. Others spiral into unstoppable chaos.

Every unit matters

Early units never fully retire. As the game progresses they unlock new abilities, synergies, and scaling hooks that can turn “trash” into core pieces of your late-game army. How well you keep them relevant is part of the decision-making.

Key Features

  • Semi-idle RTS with zero micromanagement

  • Massive auto-battles with hundreds to thousands of units

  • Incremental scaling and exponential army growth

  • Multiple distinct army archetypes and upgrade paths

  • 300+ upgrades that actually change how you play

  • Low-tier units remain relevant throughout the game

  • Enemy surges that pressure every build

  • Hand-drawn paper aesthetic

Build an industry without borders

Industry Unbound is a single-player factory automation strategy game set on an infinite canvas. Begin with raw deposits and a fragile settlement, then design the mining, processing, power, and logistics networks that turn a planet into a self-sustaining industrial system.

Every building, route, cache, and power source belongs to the same living network. Place facilities, choose recipes, connect material-specific lines, manage throughput and congestion, and diagnose bottlenecks before shortages disrupt your plans. Power limits, construction supplies, storage, research, and human needs all shape the factory you build.

Plan, automate, expand

Build on an infinite canvas. Place mines, furnaces, assemblers, generators, storage, research facilities, and more where your network needs them.

Make logistics visible. Route individual materials, inspect line capacity and in-transit stock, and respond to blocked outputs or missing inputs.

Balance a real power grid. Match generation, storage, and demand as industrial expansion puts pressure on the network.

Research new capabilities. Produce and deliver physical research materials to unlock more buildings, recipes, and expansion options.

Keep settlements supplied. Reliable food, water, and industrial support let people survive, recover, and contribute to long-term growth.

Pursue planetary-scale projects. Coordinate construction and deliveries for major engineering milestones while your factory continues to run.

Learn the core systems through the in-game tutorial, then continue in an open-ended planetary mode where the next bottleneck, production route, and expansion plan are yours to solve.

Build Megastructures, Shape Your Own Cosmos

Channel your factory’s output into monumental space projects. Deliver materials and watch Dyson spheres and deep-space observatories take shape, powering industrial expansion and revealing distant horizons. In the Megastructure Workshop, freely combine components, build structural frameworks, and customize layouts, colors, and lighting to create your own megastructure designs—and place your creations among the stars.

Tactical turn-based wizarding combat on a battlefield you can change.

Spill, freeze, burn, and combine alchemical substances to reshape the battlefield. Blood can become medicine. Fire can harm one creature and heal another. Learn how these systems interact, and find your own ways to survive.

Move into position, throw and teleport your enemies around, synergize spell effects, and use the environment to gain an advantage.

Gather cards, modify your spells, and adapt to each run.

Descend into the Hollow Earth in a roguelite deckbuilder by solo developer reynvert.

Electric damage travels through connected Water, letting one spell hit several enemies.

Freeze Water to stop it conducting your attack back to you.

Ignite Oil for a chain reaction that damages and pushes nearby enemies.

These are just a few examples.

Discover more reactions and ways to use the environment.

Heat harms Organic creatures but heals Golemic ones.

Heal restores Organic health but damages the Damned.

These are just two combinations.

Every health type has its own response to each type of damage and to healing.

Mix Blood with Alkahest, then recover health with the resulting Azoth.

Hurt a Toxic creature with its own bilious blood by converting its Bile into explosive Vitriol.

Convert Phlegm into Verdigris and step into it to gain Shield each turn.

Conduct Psychic damage through Melancholia, an emotional medium, to hurt several enemies with one spell.

These are only a few recipes.

Discover more substances, conversions, and ways to utilize them.

Mankind looked to the stars. The enemy was waiting below.

Beneath Earth's crust lies Inearth: a vast Underworld of ancient beings, alien life, and human settlements. The myths we dismissed as superstition were but distorted accounts of what waited below. Mankind descended with scientists, soldiers, and machinery, determined to understand, settle, and subdue Inearth.

Our expansion reawakened the Worldroot, an ancient organism whose branches connect distant worlds. New Gates open every day, making way for extraterrestrial horrors.

To contain the threat, VEIL abducts ordinary people with an inherited ability to manipulate matter. It gives them basic training and sends them below.

You are Subject Yellow. Your task is to reach a Gate, cross it and sever the Worldroot branch from the other side.

Success will close the Gate behind you and strand you on an alien world.

Mankind will gain a little more time.

  • 180+ spell cards in 8 different elemental domains

  • 50+ item cards

  • 100+ rule-bending gifts

  • 80+ NPC types (both enemies and allies)

  • 38 interactive substances (both surfaces and clouds)

  • 9 damage types and 9 health types

  • 160+ interactive effects (such as Bleed or Burn)

  • 3 playable characters

Descend. Close the Gate. Do not expect to return.

As above, so below.

Every shape you break has more sides than the last. Reach the circle.

Steer your lens through a drifting field of neon polygons and watch them burst into their own triangles. Spend the shards on a constellation of upgrades that reveals itself as you grow, unlock squares, pentagons, hexagons and beyond, and set off chain reactions that fill the whole screen.

Geometry is the mechanic.

Shapes that touch glue along an edge: two triangles make a square, two squares make a hexagon. Break a big shape and it splits along a diagonal into smaller ones. Let the field grow into rich, high-sided polygons, or harvest it now. Your call.

You are a shape too.

Your lens starts as a triangle. Every corner holds a facet: Ember, Fork lightning, Gravity, Catalyst and more. Identical facets fuse into stronger ones, and matching neighbors link. Gain corners as you climb.

Every run is different.

Break a golden shape and time stops: choose a Theorem. Pythagoras makes critical hits leap, Euler sets off free Novas, Zeno slows time, Crescendo rewards breaking shapes in rising order. Stack them, combine them with your facets, and break the game.

Some shapes bite back.

Star polygons hunt your lens and eat your time. Dodge them, or burst them for Prisms.

Play actively, or don't. Detonate Novas, chase prismatic shapes and time your satellites. Or unlock Autopilot, shrink the game into an always-on-top idle strip at the bottom of your screen, and let the Bloom grow while you work, even while the game is closed.

A climb with an ending.

The Heart waits at the top of the constellation. Every crack you leave in it stays. Break it and the lattice shifts into a new dimension, with new colors, tougher shapes and richer rewards.

I got tired of games that force you to start from scratch over and over: every new run wipes most of your progress back to zero. Your gear is gone, your skills are gone, and that powerful build you spent hours perfecting is gone too.

So I set out to make a game that's a blast from start to finish — one that lets you sit back and let the game play itself.

Infinite Loop is a bullet-heaven game that puts progression above the run. Every bit of growth you earn in the world of code is saved permanently. Close the game tonight, open it tomorrow, and you'll be right where you left off. No effort ever goes to waste.

No more being yanked out of the game mid-run because mom called you for dinner.

Core progression systems:

Levels · Custom Skill Bar · Talents · Chips

Core gameplay systems:

Standard Stages · Siege Battles

🗺️ 4 Maps · 25 Skills · 22 Monster Types

Each map has its own unique monsters and skill pool.

Skill names are drawn from programming terms: Byte Bolt, Recursive Grenade, Deadlock Flywheel, Pointer Seeker... Bullets bounce, spiral, split, and home in on targets, each with its own damage mechanic — how you combine them is up to your ingenuity.

Swap skills anytime mid-battle. No need to start a whole new run just to try a new skill combo.

🧩 12 Chips — The Core of Your Build

The core components of every playstyle. Equipped chips alter how bullets behave — more bullets, more explosions, more effects — making battles even more explosive.

🌳 17 Talents — Continuous Growth

Every battle earns rewards, your main driving force for pushing through stages. Wrong choices can be reset at no cost.

🏰 Two Game Modes

Standard Stages: progress through the current map; clear it to unlock a tougher next one.

Siege Challenge: unlocks once your kill count reaches the threshold. Raises your Chip Energy cap and unlocks new chips.

The Demo Is Live

The free Demo is available on Steam — the first map is fully playable, and progress carries over to the full version.

Ideas, questions, or bugs — feel free to tell me on the Steam Community Hub.

Thank you for every piece of feedback.

Infinite Loop: Incremental is a text-based idle RPG. You play as a traveler stranded in a strange world, trapped in an endless cycle of rebirth. Through each reincarnation, you will travel across time, alter fate, and write your own story, until you finally break free from the loop and find your way home.

Choice and Automation

On your journey, you will face countless choices: gather, craft, fight, explore. Plan the order of your actions in advance, and the game will carry them out according to your strategy. Every action can be automated after you complete it once in full. Arrange your automation priorities, and let your strategy run itself. But strategy is only the beginning. Death cannot be escaped.

Meta Progression

Each death rewards you with Time Marks based on what you accomplished in that life. Spend them freely on the upgrades you want, making every rebirth stronger than the last, allowing you to overcome the obstacles that once stopped you. And Time Marks have other uses beyond raw strength.

Unlock New Content

After each rebirth, you can use Time Marks to unlock new actions, gaining access to more resources, experiencing different stories, and pushing further than ever before. Some unlocks will reshape the world, introduce people and discoveries you have never encountered, alter the course of the story, and even rewrite history and destiny itself.

Adventure in the Otherworld

You arrive in a strange and dangerous world. You have come into possession of an artifact imbued with the power of time and space. Before you can even understand what is happening, hunger and monster attacks strike one after another.

As your journey unfolds, you will meet the people of this land, face its disasters together, and uncover the truth of this world, step by step.

Every rebirth erases your memories of what came before. But in every rebirth, you never lose sight of why you began.

Early Access

The current Early Access build contains Chapters 1 to 3, where players can experience the story of the Western Continent. The full version is planned to further expand the gameplay with more chapters and content. More content will be released gradually throughout Early Access.

Wishlist now!

Cards That Vanish When Used


Every card is consumable: play it once and it is gone forever. You don't "build" a deck. You decide when and where to spend a finite supply of cards. Every move carries weight, the way scrolls and wands do in a classic roguelike.

Into a Picture Book Someone Stopped Drawing


You are inside a picture book someone stopped drawing. The ink has dried, the story has stopped mid-page, and the people in it are slowly being forgotten. Two guardians of living stationery travel 99 pages to win the lost tale back.

Two Guardians


Choose two of the four guardians to form a party of two, each with their own HP, level, and equipment. Ways to bring a fallen ally back are few. Save that revival item, or use it now? As the bond between the pair deepens, new paths open in both story and battle.

Growth & Equipment


Defeat enemies to level up. Equip a sword (attack), a shield (defense), and a bookmark (special effects), then upgrade and engrave them at the smithy. Cards, gear, and your gold all have to work together if you want to reach the depths.

99 Floors, and What Waits at the Bottom


Clear one picture book and the next one opens, and beyond them all lies a dungeon 99 floors deep. Every book ends with a boss of its own. And on the deepest page, something is waiting for the two of you. You'll only find out what it is at journey's end.

A World of Ink and Watercolor


Pencil lines, bleeding ink, and washes of watercolor: a storybook world that changes its colors page by page, and mirrors the sorrow of a tale fading away.

Add Ink & Lore to your wishlist to follow the news and the launch.

Inn Over Your Head is an incremental strategy game where you manage a bustling tavern with a deadly dungeon beneath it. Serve ale, expand your tavern, and watch the gold pile up, then spend it digging deeper into the dungeon below. Place treasure to lure adventurers to their doom, arm your floors with traps and monsters, and harvest the souls of the fallen to grow even stronger. With tavern automation, dungeon customization, and numbers that never stop going up, there's always something to optimize.

Pour Ale, Make Gold

Upgrade your tavern to serve more drinks and keep the gold flowing. Every copper counts when there's a dungeon to dig.

Build Tables, Fill Seats

Expand your tavern to accommodate more guests. More adventurers drinking means more adventurers delving.

Unlock the Dungeon

Dig deeper into the mega-dungeon beneath your tavern. Each floor is deadlier and more profitable than the last.

Lure Adventurers to Their Doom

Place treasure on dungeon floors to post quests on your tavern's quest board. The better the bait, the stronger the adventurers who come looking.

Arm the Dungeon

Fill your rooms with traps and monsters. Customize every floor to ensure no adventurer makes it out alive. Traps and monster rooms have unique effects, so you can deal with even the strongest adventurers

Collect their souls???

When adventurers fall, collect their soul to unlock powerful automation.

EXILE

Branded expendable by your own government, you are sent into the Interzone, a sealed quarantine where survival is not promised, only expected.

THE INTERZONE

A dark, violent top down open world consumed by collapse, contamination, and unknown anomalies.

  • A fractured territory with shifting dangers

  • Systems have failed, nothing is stable

  • The environment is as deadly as any enemy



COMMUNICATION

The outside world cannot reach you normally.

  • Orders arrive through artillery fired capsules

  • Messages are fragmented and unreliable

  • Tools sent to you are temporary and flawed



SURVIVAL

Everything revolves around staying alive.

  • Manage hunger, thirst, and exhaustion

  • Monitor radiation and contamination levels

  • Limited medical supplies and recovery options



SCAVENGING

Search what remains of a broken world.

  • Loot abandoned buildings and ruins

  • Explore military zones and underground areas

  • Find food, water, ammo, and rare components



CRAFTING

Create what you cannot find.

  • Craft weapons, tools, and survival gear

  • Repair and reinforce equipment



COMBAT

Every fight is a risk.

  • Face infected, survivors, and hostile factions

  • Use melee weapons, firearms, and explosives

  • Ammunition is scarce, every shot matters



ANOMALIES

The world itself is unstable.

  • Deadly environmental hazards

  • Distort space, damage, or kill instantly

  • Some generate rare and valuable artifacts or might teleport you to different areas



WEAPONS

Adapt your loadout to survive.

  • Melee weapons and improvised tools

  • Pistols, rifles, and shotguns

  • Military grade equipment and rare finds


WORLD & BIOMES

A hostile and varied landscape.

  • Contaminated urban ruins

  • Radioactive industrial zones

  • Dead forests warped by anomalies

  • Military exclusion areas

  • Underground networks and tunnels

FACTIONS

You are not alone.

  • Rebel scavengers

  • Military remnants

  • Black market traders

  • Desperate survivors

  • Infected swarms

QUESTS & OBJECTIVES

Nothing is clearly given.

  • Orders delivered through shells

  • Tasks discovered through exploration

  • Clear zones, retrieve items, investigate anomalies

  • Your actions shift the balance

FINAL

The past is gone.
The Interzone remains.

LEAVE THE GREY BEHIND

It's 2031; you're looking for a way out.

Concrete prisms. Work. Money. Screens. That slowly churning feeling that something is wrong. Then an old man puts up an ad and sells you a half-ruined house in the northern mountains for almost nothing.

You probably should wonder why.

Into the Country is a story-rich life sim and visual novel about leaving modern life behind and trying to build something smaller and stranger, while searching for meaning in the remote village of Seishin.

There are mountains to climb. Streams to fish. Food to find. People to know.

And there are places not to go, and people perhaps better left unknown.

BUILD A LIFE YOU CAN TOUCH

Cut those logs! Move those chickens! Yank those plants!

Many of Into the Country's activities are designed to feel tactile and physical. Navigate through spaces, handle objects, reel in a struggling fish, pull forage from plants, split timber, start engines, and interact directly with the world around you. 

Everyday work sits alongside first-person exploration, changing weather and time, wildlife, hidden places, complex characters, all playing out under a completely original (human-made) soundtrack.

It's not a bad place to settle. Maybe even to live... For a while.

EXPERIENCE AND SHAPE THEIR STORIES

The people of Seishin had lives long before you arrived.

They have histories, flaws, wants, strengths, conflicts and moods of their own. Talk to them. Help them. Get involved. Take sides. Influence them, and let them influence you.

Water someone's plants. Run an errand. Help when a crisis hits — or decide not to.

Friendship can become intimacy. Intimacy can become love, rivalry, resentment, sex, or something harder to define. Your choices shape the people you grow close to and the community you're becoming part of.

Not everything begins neatly. Not everything ends that way, either.

THE WORLD IS ERODING LIKE SAND

You came here to get away from everything.

Unfortunately, everything followed.

The world beyond the mountains is becoming more expensive, unstable and angry. Strange events become harder to dismiss. Old wounds beneath Seishin begin to surface. People disappear, break down, lash out, and cling harder to one another.

At first, distance makes all of that easy to ignore, but a darkness migrates upward.

Into the Country is ultimately a story about beauty, work, love, mortality, and what people owe one another when the future stops feeling infinite.

Build something while you still can.

Trailer music: “High Road” | Pamela Yuen | CC BY 4.0 | modified for Into the Country

Into the Planet's Flesh is a cozy, creepy incremental game about overrunning a planet.

Hatch all kinds of parasites, spread veined buildings through the earth, and collect many different grotesque resources to make the planet hurtle toward its doom even faster.

Hatch larvae. Put them to work.

Clicking to harvest is the only mechanic you need to know in order to get started. You'll unlock interesting units and buildings that do all the heavy lifting for you.

Grow organs that unlock new resources.

As your colony grows, so will a grotesque spectacle--watch what happens when these malicious bugs show up in a pristine natural environment.

Play actively if you want, but it's totally cool to let the colony run by itself while you check on it from time to time. The visual spectacle is fun even if you aren't constantly clicking on it!

The planet will notice what you're up to.

But beware--the planet won't give up its resources so easily.

Your environment changes visibly as you make progress throughout the game.

At first, it'll just try to scare you, but...

Soon enough, something will awaken from deep under the earth...

Master the art of parasite-driven planet killing

  • Over 25 different types of parasites that each work in different ways

  • 15+ unique buildings, requiring you to learn how they function, such as the mystic Adventure Portal, the artifact-crafting Bone Workshop, and the warlike Militarized Colon

  • Unlock over 20 prestige upgrades, including completely new buildings and ways to gather resources

  • 13 (and counting) visual environmental changes with gameplay effects

  • Every resource is meaningful--your work with previous resources will boost future unlocks and units

  • Discover what happens when your parasites VENTURE TOO DEEP

  • Less than 5 hours of total required playtime to see the ending. Short, but creepy!

Investor Incremental is all about establishing financial freedom. Begin as a Stamp worker in a dead-end job and invest in stocks to (hopefully) make a killing. Watch your finances grow, choose the most profitable company to invest in, follow news and the latest developments of the market, and manipulate the market in your favour.

Features:

  • Procedurally Generated Stock Market

  • Market News

  • Stocks with different volatility levels

  • Social Media

  • Job Automation Upgrades

  • 65+ Upgrades that meaningfully develop your game

  • Hours of fun

  • No time pressure - sit back and watch your finances grow

A LONG ADVENTURE THAT FITS BESIDE YOUR DAY

Iris's Idle Log is a quiet, long-form idle RPG about preparation, discovery, and steady growth. Follow Iris and her mysterious companion, Bibi, as a small adventure log expands across new areas, resources, skills, and challenges.

The game supports a portrait layout, letting you place it freely in a corner of your screen and enjoy it while doing something else.

PREPARE WELL. PUSH FARTHER.

Exploration and combat unfold automatically, but your decisions shape every journey. Equip weapons and armor, prepare food, train Action Skills, and choose the area you want to explore.

Each new item, meal, rank, and upgrade gives Iris the strength to travel farther on her next exploration.

BUILD YOUR OWN GROWTH ROUTE

Progress reaches far beyond combat. A wide range of interconnected Life Skills lets you decide what Iris works on and how one part of her routine supports the next.

- Gather and Produce - Mining, Logging, Fishing, and Farming

- Craft and Prepare - Cooking, Brewing, Crafting, Smithing, and Enchanting

- Learn and Create - Training, Meditation, Rest, Familiar Training, Instrument Performance, Painting, and Writing

- Trade and Discover - Stealth, Commerce, Cartography, Camping, and Expedition

Gather raw materials, turn them into useful equipment and consumables, improve Iris's stats, unlock new destinations, and shape a progression route of your own.

PROGRESS THAT CONTINUES WHILE YOU ARE AWAY

Set up Auto Explore, dispatch an Expedition, or leave Iris working on a Life Skill before you step away. Even after you close the game, her routine continues offline, and a summary shows what happened when you return.

Check in for a moment, collect your progress, choose the next goal, and let Iris continue at your pace. Whether you actively plan every step or leave her to work while you focus on something else, her day keeps moving forward.

WRITE THE NEXT PAGE WITH IRIS

Explore unfamiliar areas, complete Objectives, discover resources, and prepare to face stronger enemies. Iris's world opens little by little through small decisions and steady growth - one task, one return, and one page at a time.

What will you gather today? What will you make next? How far will Iris travel before she turns back?

The county is yours. So is the blame.

You're the bainisteoir. Not a chairman, not a director of football. The one in the county jacket on the sideline, appointed by a board that expects a championship and will settle for a decent run at it.

There is no transfer market. Your panel comes out of your county's own clubs, from the parishes on the map. You get the thirty you get, and you answer for the ones you leave out.

  • Watch it live: a ticking clock and the whole match played out on the pitch, every score as it happens.

  • Make your switches while play runs. Burn your subs early if you have to. Pick your moment for the speech at the break.

  • Every day has its weather: wind down the field, rain, a ground anywhere from firm to heavy. Win the toss and choose your ends.

  • Every match has a named referee with a way about them: strict or lenient, swayed by a crowd or deaf to it. Protest a call from the sideline and you may finish the match in the stand.

  • After the whistle your coach reports what worked, what didn't and what to change, and the press want a word.

  • Football, hurling, camogie and ladies' football. You manage one; the other three run on the same calendar, with the dual players and the fixture pile-up that come with them.

  • January's pre-season cups, a league where your division pays the bills, the provincial championships, then the summer, shaped by each code's own format, the 2026 football format among them.

  • Four national finals at the National Stadium in Dublin. A level knockout goes the way its code's rulebook says: extra time, a replay, or both.

  • Fill the quiet weeks with a challenge match against another county, or an A v B with the second fifteen in bibs.

  • Every county is its parishes, and the surnames belong to a place: a Power where the Powers are from.

  • Call a club player into the panel and choose who goes back to make room.

  • What you know about a club player is what your selectors have seen. If nobody has watched them, the numbers in front of you are a guess.

  • The rules let a few more in: a player with a parent from the county can declare for it, and hurling's smaller counties have their special provisions.

  • Teach a corner-back to play midfield if that's what you're short of. Answer a disciplinary charge inside two days or the proposed penalty stands.

  • When the county year ends, the clubs' begins: every county's club leagues and championships, grade by grade, then the provincial and national club competitions.

  • Release your players to their clubs, and hear about it when the clubs want them back.

  • Or take a club instead of a county: a parish side with a committee to answer to, a backroom hired from the parish on expenses, and the same sideline.

  • A philosophy (kicking, balanced, possession or running), your restarts and how you press theirs, your shape at the back, the half-backs, the half-forwards, the defensive line and the tackle. Each one buys an edge in one place and pays for it somewhere else.

  • Give any player orders: how much they shoot, where they run, how they tackle. They follow them as far as their character allows.

  • Name a free-taker, a long-range option, a target up front and a target for your keeper's restarts. Put markers on up to six of their players, tight or goal-side, or two on their danger, and find out whether your marker is the kind of player who does that job.

  • Change it mid-match and it takes hold at the next passage of play, not the second you click.

  • The other sideline reads your plan as well as its coach can, and has answers of its own.

  • Between the Sundays the post arrives. A wedding the night before a championship match. A J1 summer in Boston. A bull on the fifty an hour before training.

  • Ten days to answer, and the answer runs through everything else.

  • A quiet word: praise a purple patch, demand more from a player in a slump, talk somebody out of the boats for one more winter. One word a month with each player, so pick it.

  • Write your own events in plain JSON and put them on the Workshop.

  • Start in January, the league or the championship, or take a side in trouble at the bottom of its division.

  • Board confidence, sackings, and the job market that comes after them.

  • Have a good year and another county's board makes a quiet call. Have a bad one and the press ask whether your position is tenable.

  • Every season goes on your record: the trophies, the heaviest defeat, the year you'd rather forget.

  • A cup buys you time. It does not buy you the job.

  • Retire when you choose, or after the season you turn eighty, and the world goes on with your successor.

  • Build a world of your own: counties, regions, colours, jerseys, crests, how well each brings on its young, and the places their clubs are named after.

  • Set up the competitions, leagues and championships, the way you want them run.

  • Name packs put your own names on the players.

  • Share worlds, name packs and stories on the Steam Workshop. A world of your own plays with achievements off.

The name on the door

There's no official license here. The governing body in the game is the Home Games Association, the HGA, and the competitions, trophies and venues are its own. The counties are real and so is the calendar. The parishes are real places. The clubs and the players are invented.

Irish Sport Manager is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or licensed by the Gaelic Athletic Association, the Ladies Gaelic Football Association, the Camogie Association, or any county board. All governing bodies, competitions, trophies, venues, clubs and players in the game are fictional.
